newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end weaker but off session lows - jan 23.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end weaker but off session lows - jan 23.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended mixed after a volatile day on Thursday, with indices closing slightly down, but traders said the underlying tone remained positive.
The General index closed down 1.15 points, 0.24 percent, to 474.66. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares closed down 12.33 points, 0.23 percent, to 5,450.74.
"Voltality was again evident in the bourse which reflects nothing more than doubts in the short term," said one trader.
Turnover was lower than seen in previous days, with 71.85 billion pesetas changing hands.
Traders said a weak peseta and debt market had weighed on shares during the session.
Dealers said they expected further consolidation on Friday with some profit-taking ahead of the weekend.
Among individual stocks, BBV was up 30 pesetas to 7,910 pesetas after posting 1996 results which came in line with expectations.
Telefonica ended 10 pesetas higher at 3,380, while Repsol added 10 pesetas to 5,960.
